title: Cloud Canopy: Ecological Restoration

foundation.history: The suspended library was built to protect aerial roots, but severe canopy winds interrupted its stewardship.

premise: Noa Alto, a field ecologist, must rebuild the broken food web using resource stewardship while severe canopy winds threatens the suspended library.
central_conflict: a resource consortium seeks control of aerial roots; residents want accountable access.

plot_beats.name: Arrival
plot_beats.cause: severe canopy winds isolates the suspended library
plot_beats.effect: Local routes and witnesses become inaccessible

plot_beats.name: The bargain
plot_beats.cause: a resource consortium offers privileged access to aerial roots
plot_beats.effect: The player must decide whether to share information

plot_beats.name: The remedy
plot_beats.cause: The production plan determines who controls the restored system
plot_beats.effect: Faction trust changes the final public arrangement

endings.consequence: Stewardship passes to a representative public council
Resident cooperatives operate the recovered infrastructure
The essential route survives with unresolved governance debts
